- Temporary access constraints: ephemeral tokens, no indexing, and destruction confirmation after 60 days.

Elena — appreciate the note and excited to run this with Acme. Quick confirmation of what we propose and next steps:

Proposed MAP (summary):
- Scope: Exchange of an evaluation sample basket (~4k records) + a 20-prompt seed pack. Redwood will provide ephemeral access to a hosted sandbox instance (Redwood Private demo) and a checksum-backed archive for ingestion.
- Security & usage constraints: Data is allowed for pilot evaluation only (no training, no external indexing), retained for a 60-day evaluation window, then purged unless Acme requests extended retention in writing.
- Acceptance criteria: 1) pass baseline QA suite (functional parity on 10 seed tasks), 2) response latency within agreed SLOs for 95th percentile, 3) qualitative scoring >= 0.75 on acme-annotator rubrics.
- Delivery cadence: Redwood sends a sealed archive + access credentials within 5 business days of MAP sign-off. Acme provides acceptance verdict within 10 business days after handoff.
- Audit & proof: Redwood will provide MD5 checksums and an audit log CSV; Acme can run spot checks.

I'll attach a one-page MAP and a checklist for procurement to this thread. Monica, Priyom — can you confirm the sandbox provisioning ETA if Acme signs today?

Best,
Markus
Markus Klein

Looping in operations + quick ops notes for the MAP handoff:

- Sandbox provisioning: we can provision a named ephemeral sandbox (region us-west1) within 48 hours of receiving the sealed archive and procurement sign-off. Access will be timeboxed and tokenized (60-day TTL).
- Data transport: prefer encrypted tarball delivered via our secure transfer link (we'll generate per-transfer S3 presigned URL). We will include a manifest and MD5s.
- Watermarking / markers: we recommend adding a small canonical marker to testcases so we can prove lineage at audit — we'll add guidance in the checklist.
- Audit kill-switch: if any policy breach is reported, we can revoke tokens and trigger immediate purge; we'll provide purge confirmation and log entries.

Priyom — please draft the acceptance checklist and a brief promptpack README (usage guardrails + prohibited activities) and drop into Drive link below.

Thanks,

Subject: MAP + prompt pack README + acceptance checklist (draft)

Hi all — attached is the initial package for review:
- acme_map_v1.pdf (MAP summary & timeline)
- promptpack-sample.tar.gz (20 prompts + README)
- acme_acceptance_checklist.xlsx (acceptance gates and scoring rubric)

Key points in the checklist (summary):
1) Functional gates (automated): 10 seeded tasks with pass/fail threshold; automated runner included.
2) Performance gates: 95th pctl token-latency <= 250ms on the sandbox (measured by Redwood tracing).
3) Quality gates: human annotation on a 200-sample pass set; mean score >= 0.75.
4) Usage constraints: no training; restricted to pilot environment; no derivative dataset publication.
5) Retention: sandbox access + raw archive deleted after 60 days; Acme can request extension in writing.

Elena — can you confirm Acme is comfortable with the 60-day TTL and the listed acceptance gates? Once you confirm, we'll issue the secure transfer link and start provisioning.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
